description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ihala Pohorabawa, Kuruvita D/S/Division Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620352 (24/0533)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and land classification details. The content focuses on property ownership and land title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
